name: ItemTemplateSectionInput
description: Represents the input for creating or updating a template section.

inputFields.name: fields
inputFields.description: The template fields of the template section. If field ID is provided, the field will be updated. Otherwise, new field will be created.

inputFields.name: icon
inputFields.description: The icon of the template section.

inputFields.name: name
inputFields.description: The name of the template section.

inputFields.name: sortOrder
inputFields.description: The sort order of the template section.

inputFields.name: templateSectionId
inputFields.description: The unique ID of the template section. If the ID is empty, a new template section will be created. Otherwise, the template section will be updated.
